shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在农田和污水池的背景板前，手里拿着放大镜
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a backdrop of farm fields and a wastewater pond, holding a magnifying glass, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 有些微生物，专吃人类留下的毒物。
overlay: 吃农药、吸重金属的微生物

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现两个图标：农药喷雾瓶、工厂排水管
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to two floating icons: a spray bottle with a skull pictogram and a factory drain pipe.
shots.narration: 今天两道题：农药和重金属。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰在课题组会上听老周布置任务
shots.prompt_en: The young male student listens at a group meeting while the older man points to a blank project chart.
shots.narration: 阿杰新加入一个环境修复课题。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 老周递给阿杰一袋土样和一瓶空白标签的废水样
shots.prompt_en: The older man hands the young male student a sealed bag of soil and a water sample bottle with a blank label.
shots.narration: 老周说：从这些样品里找降解菌。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰兴奋地伸手就要打开土样袋，小研伸手拦住
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reaches eagerly to open the soil bag without gloves, and the female graduate student holds up her hand to stop him.
shots.narration: 阿杰急着动手，小研拦住了他。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 先认识这些菌，再说怎么安全地做。

shots.section_title: 恶臭假单胞菌：降解有机磷农药
shots.scene: 一株杆状细菌图标靠近一个农药分子球棍模型
shots.prompt_en: A rod-shaped bacterium icon approaches a ball-and-stick molecule icon beside a spray bottle pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：哪些微生物最会降解农药？
overlay: 恶臭假单胞菌：降解有机磷农药

shots.section_title: 恶臭假单胞菌：降解有机磷农药
shots.scene: 杆菌把分子模型拆成几个小球
shots.prompt_en: The rod-shaped bacterium breaks the molecule model into several small separate balls. No people.
shots.narration: 恶臭假单胞菌，能分解有机磷农药，

shots.section_title: 恶臭假单胞菌：降解有机磷农药
shots.scene: 农田土壤剖面中，小杆菌在土粒间活动
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section of farm soil with tiny rod-shaped bacteria moving between soil grains. No people.
shots.narration: 把残留在土里的农药慢慢清掉。

shots.section_title: 枯草芽孢杆菌：分解除草剂
shots.scene: 田边一株枯萎的杂草和除草剂瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: A withered weed at the edge of a field beside a herbicide bottle pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 再看除草剂。
overlay: 枯草芽孢杆菌：分解除草剂

shots.section_title: 枯草芽孢杆菌：分解除草剂
shots.scene: 一群杆菌围住除草剂分子，分子逐渐变小
shots.prompt_en: A group of rod-shaped bacteria surround a herbicide molecule icon, which gradually shrinks. No people.
shots.narration: 枯草芽孢杆菌，能分解阿特拉津这类除草剂。

shots.section_title: 白腐真菌：靠酶分解含氯农药
shots.scene: 朽木上长着一片白色真菌菌丝
shots.prompt_en: A rotting log covered with a patch of white fungal threads. No people.
shots.narration: 真菌也是好手。
overlay: 白腐真菌：靠酶分解含氯农药

shots.section_title: 白腐真菌：靠酶分解含氯农药
shots.scene: 菌丝放出小剪刀形状的酶图标，剪开带氯原子的分子
shots.prompt_en: The fungal threads release small scissor-shaped enzyme icons that snip a molecule with green chlorine balls. No people.
shots.narration: 白腐真菌分泌木质素过氧化物酶，

shots.section_title: 白腐真菌：靠酶分解含氯农药
shots.scene: 带氯原子的分子碎成小片
shots.prompt_en: The molecule with green chlorine balls breaks into small harmless-looking pieces. No people.
shots.narration: 把难分解的含氯农药拆开。

shots.section_title: 细菌能去除废水里的重金属
shots.scene: 工厂排水管流出带灰色颗粒的污水
shots.prompt_en: A factory drain pipe releases murky water carrying grey metal particles. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：细菌能除掉废水里的重金属吗？
overlay: 细菌能去除废水里的重金属

shots.section_title: 细菌能去除废水里的重金属
shots.scene: 一个大大的绿色对勾
shots.prompt_en: A big green check mark appears over a clean water drop icon. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是：能。

shots.section_title: 地杆菌、希瓦氏菌：把六价铬还原
shots.scene: 细菌贴在一个黄色金属颗粒上，颗粒颜色由深变浅
shots.prompt_en: Bacteria attach to a bright yellow metal particle, which changes to a pale green color. No people.
shots.narration: 地杆菌和希瓦氏菌，能把金属还原。
overlay: 地杆菌、希瓦氏菌：把六价铬还原

shots.section_title: 地杆菌、希瓦氏菌：把六价铬还原
shots.scene: 一个大红色骷髅图标变成一个浅色小图标
shots.prompt_en: A large red skull pictogram shrinks and turns into a small pale icon. No people.
shots.narration: 比如把六价铬变成三价铬，

shots.section_title: 地杆菌、希瓦氏菌：把六价铬还原
shots.scene: 可溶的金属离子在水里沉到瓶底
shots.prompt_en: Dissolved metal particles in water settle to the bottom of a flask as a sediment. No people.
shots.narration: 毒性大大降低，也更容易除去。

shots.section_title: 耐金属罗尔斯通菌：细胞壁吸附铅镉
shots.scene: 一个细菌的细胞壁上粘满灰色金属小球
shots.prompt_en: A bacterium whose cell wall is covered with small grey metal balls stuck to its surface. No people.
shots.narration: 耐金属罗尔斯通菌，像块吸附海绵，
overlay: 耐金属罗尔斯通菌：细胞壁吸附铅镉

shots.section_title: 耐金属罗尔斯通菌：细胞壁吸附铅镉
shots.scene: 水里的金属小球不断被吸到细菌表面
shots.prompt_en: Grey metal balls drift through water and keep sticking onto the bacterium's surface. No people.
shots.narration: 把铅和镉吸附在自己的细胞壁上。

shots.section_title: 荧光假单胞菌：把汞变得毒性低些
shots.scene: 一滴银色的汞滴和骷髅图标
shots.prompt_en: A shiny silver mercury droplet icon next to a skull pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 汞，是毒性很强的重金属。
overlay: 荧光假单胞菌：把汞变得毒性低些

shots.section_title: 荧光假单胞菌：把汞变得毒性低些
shots.scene: 细菌吞入汞图标，放出颜色较浅的小图标
shots.prompt_en: A bacterium takes in a mercury icon and releases a smaller, paler icon. No people.
shots.narration: 荧光假单胞菌能转化汞，

shots.section_title: 荧光假单胞菌：把汞变得毒性低些
shots.scene: 汞图标从深红变成浅黄，但仍带一个小警示三角
shots.prompt_en: The mercury icon changes from dark red to light yellow, but still carries a small warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 变成毒性较低的形态，但仍要小心。

shots.section_title: 土里分出的菌：先当未知菌
shots.scene: 欣欣举着一袋土样，土样上画着问号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a sealed soil bag with a big question mark icon on it.
shots.narration: 土里、水里分出来的菌，
overlay: 土里分出的菌：先当未知菌

shots.section_title: 土里分出的菌：先当未知菌
shots.scene: 一个平板上长出好几种菌落，有的被问号圈住
shots.prompt_en: A culture dish grows several kinds of colonies, some circled with question marks. No people.
shots.narration: 可能混着致病菌，鉴定前是未知菌。

shots.section_title: 土里分出的菌：先当未知菌
shots.scene: 王老师和老周在空白风险评估表上讨论
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the older man discuss a blank risk assessment form at a desk.
shots.narration: 先做风险评估，再定防护级别。

shots.section_title: 土里分出的菌：先当未知菌
shots.scene: 阿杰在二级实验室的生物安全柜里开土样袋
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, in lab coat, gloves and goggles, opens the soil bag inside a biosafety cabinet in a lab with a biohazard warning sign on the door.
shots.narration: 一般在二级实验室、安全柜里操作。

shots.section_title: 土里分出的菌：先当未知菌
shots.scene: 冰箱里的分离株管子都贴着空白标签和问号图标
shots.prompt_en: Isolate tubes in a lab freezer rack, each with a blank label and a small question mark icon. No people.
shots.narration: 分离株标清来源，鉴定前不降级。

shots.section_title: 农药是毒物：防吸入、防沾皮肤
shots.scene: 农药瓶上的骷髅象形图和健康危害象形图
shots.prompt_en: A pesticide bottle with a skull pictogram and a health hazard pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 降解实验要用农药，农药本身有毒。
overlay: 农药是毒物：防吸入、防沾皮肤

shots.section_title: 农药是毒物：防吸入、防沾皮肤
shots.scene: 人形图标上，鼻子和手背两处亮起警示
shots.prompt_en: A human outline icon with warning marks lighting up at the nose and on the back of the hand. No people.
shots.narration: 可以吸进去，也能透过皮肤吸收。

shots.section_title: 农药是毒物：防吸入、防沾皮肤
shots.scene: 小研在通风柜里配制培养基，戴手套护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student prepares a medium inside a fume hood with the sash lowered, wearing gloves, goggles and a lab coat.
shots.narration: 配含农药的培养基，在通风柜里做。

shots.section_title: 农药是毒物：防吸入、防沾皮肤
shots.scene: 上锁的试剂柜和登记本
shots.prompt_en: A locked reagent cabinet with a hazard pictogram and a blank logbook beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 剧毒品种按规定领用，用多少领多少。

shots.section_title: 农药是毒物：防吸入、防沾皮肤
shots.scene: 阿杰洗手，身后实验台上放着摘下的手套
shots.prompt_en: The young male student washes his hands at the lab sink, used gloves in a waste bin beside him.
shots.narration: 沾到皮肤，马上用大量清水冲洗。

shots.section_title: 含铬、含汞废液：单独收集
shots.scene: 倒废液进水槽的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of liquid being poured into a sink drain, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 重金属实验的废液，不能倒水槽。
overlay: 含铬、含汞废液：单独收集

shots.section_title: 含铬、含汞废液：单独收集
shots.scene: 两个空白标签的废液桶分开摆放，各带一个骷髅象形图
shots.prompt_en: Two separate waste containers with blank labels, each with a skull pictogram, standing apart. No people.
shots.narration: 含铬、含汞的分开收集，贴好标签。

shots.section_title: 含铬、含汞废液：单独收集
shots.scene: 王老师在登记本上记录，旁边一辆回收车
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator records waste containers in a blank logbook beside a collection cart.
shots.narration: 交学校统一，由有资质单位处置。

shots.section_title: 含铬、含汞废液：单独收集
shots.scene: 含菌的重金属废液桶旁同时有生物危害标志和骷髅图
shots.prompt_en: A waste container showing both a biohazard warning sign and a skull pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 又有菌又有重金属的，问清再处理。

shots.section_title: 汞洒了：别扫别吸，立即报告
shots.scene: 实验台上散落的银色小珠
shots.prompt_en: Small shiny silver beads scattered across a lab bench surface. No people.
shots.narration: 汞洒了，会变成到处滚的小珠。
overlay: 汞洒了：别扫别吸，立即报告

shots.section_title: 汞洒了：别扫别吸，立即报告
shots.scene: 扫帚和吸尘器图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A broom icon and a vacuum cleaner icon, both crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 别用扫帚扫，也别用吸尘器吸。

shots.section_title: 汞洒了：别扫别吸，立即报告
shots.scene: 小研让大家离开，打开窗户，拿起电话
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student waves others away from the bench, opens a window and picks up the phone.
shots.narration: 人先离开，保持通风，报告老师。

shots.section_title: 汞洒了：别扫别吸，立即报告
shots.scene: 王老师带着专用应急箱赶来
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator arrives carrying a closed emergency kit box with a blank label.
shots.narration: 由专人用专用工具处理。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣站在两排图标前：农药与重金属
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of two rows of icons: a pesticide bottle row and a metal particle row.
shots.narration: 一起回顾一下。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 杆菌、杆菌、白色菌丝三个图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: Three icons light up: a rod bacterium, another rod bacterium, and white fungal threads. No people.
shots.narration: 假单胞菌、芽孢杆菌、白腐真菌降农药。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 还原、吸附、转化三个箭头图标
shots.prompt_en: Three arrow icons light up: a color-changing particle, metal balls sticking to a cell, and a mercury droplet turning pale. No people.
shots.narration: 重金属：还原、吸附、转化。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 土样问号和生物安全柜图标
shots.prompt_en: A soil bag with a question mark beside a biosafety cabinet icon. No people.
shots.narration: 环境分离菌，评估后在安全柜里做。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 骷髅象形图、废液桶和打叉的扫帚
shots.prompt_en: A skull pictogram, a waste container and a crossed-out broom, side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 农药防吸收，废液分开收，汞洒报告。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研一起挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye together with the young male student and the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 让微生物治污，先让自己安全，下次见！
